fullPassage: The graph above shows the percentage of people who provided unpaid care to children and adults by age group in Canada in 2022. ①Notably, the 35-44 group had the highest percentage of individuals providing unpaid care to children, reaching 59.5%. ②However, the highest percentage of individuals providing unpaid care to adults was found in the 55-64 group.
